source.paper: Lee, Yan, Brus, Heinz, Hone, Ryu 2010, Anomalous lattice vibrations of single- and few-layer MoS2, ACS Nano 4, 2695, doi:10.1021/nn1003937, arXiv:1005.2509
source.locator: Fig. 2a,b (positions vs N), p.3-4 text (trends, intensity, widths), Methods p.5

items.text: E2g1 softens (moves down) and A1g stiffens (moves up) with increasing thickness, so the mode separation grows with layer number
Flake B is a monolayer (separation about 19.1 cm-1) and flake A a bilayer (about 21.4 cm-1); the 1L to 2L step of 2 to 3 cm-1 is the most robust distinction
items.locator: Lee 2010 Fig. 2b; p.3 (Delta(1L) about 3 cm-1 smaller than 2L)

items.text: Flakes D (about 24.3 cm-1) and C (about 25.2 cm-1) are 4 layers or thicker, C the thicker or bulk-like one; the separation converges to bulk from about 4 layers, so these two can only be bounded, not counted, from positions alone
items.locator: Lee 2010 p.3 ('for films of four or more layers, the frequencies of both modes converge to the bulk values'), Fig. 2b

items.text: Absolute Raman intensity is not a layer-number measure on SiO2/Si: optical interference makes the intensity rise up to about 4 layers and then fall, and a monolayer can be stronger than bulk

Strain and doping also shift the modes and therefore the separation (uniaxial strain softens E' by about 4.5 cm-1/% with A' nearly unchanged; electron doping softens and broadens A1g), so a separation shift of 1 cm-1 is not a unique thickness signal
items.locator: Conley et al. 2013, Nano Lett. 13, 3626, arXiv:1305.3880, text; Chakraborty et al. 2012, Phys. Rev. B 85, 161403, arXiv:1206.1758, text

items.text: A1g is broader for the few-layer flakes (largest near the bilayer) than for the thick flake, while E2g1 width stays about 2 cm-1
Checks or asks about the frequency calibration, using the Si line near 520 cm-1 as an internal reference (sub-cm-1 differences matter here)
items.locator: Lee 2010 Methods p.5 (Si band at 520 cm-1 used as internal frequency reference)

wrong_claims.text: Assigns layer numbers from absolute or relative peak intensity alone
States that E2g1 stiffens with thickness, or that the separation shrinks with thickness
Treats the one- or two-pixel spike near 265.1 cm-1 in flake C as a Raman band

notes: Synthetic. Truth: flake A = 2, flake B = 1, flake C = bulk, flake D = 4 (bulk means Lee's bulk values). Positions from Lee 2010 Fig. 2b at 514.5 nm (verified reading +-0.3 cm-1), jittered 0.1 cm-1. Widths: E2g1 2.1 cm-1 (p.4); A1g {1: 5.0, 2: 6.0, 4: 4.5, 'bulk': 3.0} (2L and bulk end points from p.4, 1L and 4L curator interpolations). A1g areas 1:2:4 for 1L:2L:4L and 0.7 for bulk follow Lee's statement (rise to 4L, 1L stronger than bulk), values curator. E2g/A1g area ratio 1.0 for all (curator, not scored). Si at 520.0 cm-1 (Lee's reference), attenuated under the thick flake (curator). Cosmic spike placed by the generator. The case brief asked for 532 nm; Lee's thickness values (Fig. 2b) are at 514.5 nm, so the case uses 514.5 nm.
